scope: Full owner-provided GTM Engine script in current home/olive selfie setup

segments.text:
It’s hard to leave an app alone when it looks like something you could sell.

I’ve gotta get better at that. With AI, I can get something looking pretty good before I’ve worked out why anyone would actually use it.

So I’m building this GTM Engine to help me work through that. It looks at the code, then researches who might use it and what they’re doing already.

Because if they’ve already got a way that works, why would they bother with mine?

But I still wanna let someone try it on something they actually need to do. Do they choose mine, or go back to what they were using before?

Maybe I’ve gotta build a bit more to find that out. That’s fine.

But I’ve got other projects I wanna work on too, so I want more to go on than how good this one looks.

And if I just enjoy using it myself, I can leave it at that. It’s okay to have a hobby.

So you guys tell me, what made you decide to turn something you’d built into a business?

Vertical smartphone selfie talking-head video of this same owner-authorized adult man at home. Use the IMAGE for exact facial identity, transparent glasses, hair, stubble, skin texture, muted olive casual overshirt open over a plain off-white crew-neck T-shirt, home room, soft window light and close framing. Preserve the window and sheer curtain on image-left and wooden shelves on image-right. His own front-facing phone is held at arm's length slightly above eye level, outside the frame. Preserve stable phone-supporting arm and shoulders with small natural handheld character and everyday phone-camera texture. Preserve the close framing throughout; no new establishing shot or camera move.

The IMAGE anchors appearance and setting, not its frozen facial expression. This is one section of a longer candid personal reflection to a familiar person through the phone, not an ad or a formal presenter monologue. Carry a visibly engaged conversational performance: attentive near-lens eyes, natural blinking, small thought-responsive irregular brow/cheek movement that returns to rest, and relaxed connected articulation. Keep the upper face alive without permanent widened eyes, a fixed grin, broad mouth stretching or constant head movement.

Use the supplied AUDIO as exact current words, voice performance and timing. Start with its actual speech onset; follow its variations in pace, pitch, rhythm and emphasis. Preserve every supplied word without paraphrasing, repeating, omitting or adding speech. Finish the final word completely and settle naturally into any ending silence. The specific passage and its expression progression follow below.

Keep likeness, room, light, wardrobe, lens distance and screen direction unchanged. No repetitive nodding or eyebrow pumping, automatic start-of-clip smile, scheduled glance after every sentence, restless eyes, stock concern, blank upper face with only mouth moving, exaggerated acting or large gestures. Real-time performance.
